$comment: Default Solidity build settings for blueprint contracts. The deploy pipeline builds Standard JSON input from these, and the Builder Hub verifier needs the exact same settings, so a blueprint overrides them only through its own `compile` block.

exportRemappings.@teleporter/: Install ava-labs/icm-contracts and remap @teleporter/ to lib/icm-contracts/contracts/teleporter/ (Foundry) when moving a blueprint into a standalone repo.
